notes.title: 400 Wishlists Reached! 🎉
notes.content: [p][b]400[/b] wishlists is a milestone for me, even without a Demo yet 😅[/p][p]Thank you all for supporting Rotten Sails this early. [/p][p]It means a lot to see interest before the game even has a proper Demo or updated trailer.[/p][p]The [b]Demo is right around the corner 👀[/b] so stay tuned, and if you haven’t already, feel free to give the game a wishlist. Your wishes are my fuel ⚓💀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527027/b43703755be68148b05561cd304a41c90437972f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🦴 386 Testers Onboard Rotten Sails!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527027/b1de31ff6d2d703a9a7d33242f8897914dc1ec61.png"][/img][/p][p]Rotten Sails has already welcomed [b]386 brave testers[/b] into its cursed waters!

👉 [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3022470/Rotten_Sails/?utm_source=twitter"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]See you on deck, sailor. 🏴‍☠️[/p]

notes.title: 🌙 Rotten Sails Playtest Opens This Friday!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527027/183c0fbab54c65d7bf02ebb08c0fa59f26fb41cc.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone!  
I’m excited to share that the Rotten Sails Steam Playtest will be opening this Friday ⚓☠️  

Rotten Sails is a co-op horror pirate game where you and your crew sneak into cursed dungeons, haul treasure, and try to survive the darkness (and each other).  

If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist the game so you won’t miss when the playtest goes live!  

👉 [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3022470/Rotten_Sails/"][/dynamiclink] Playtest builds will be available in English only for now.[/p]

notes.title: Rotten Sails - New Trailer & Open Playtest Next Week!
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy sailors![/h1]

[b]Rotten Sails[/b] has big news to share:

[h2]🎬 New Trailer[/h2]
[b]Expected date: End of April 2025[/b]  
Our new gameplay trailer drops next week, featuring real players braving the cursed waters!

[h2]🎮 Open Playtest: April 30 - May 6, 2025[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thinking to make it open to everyone!
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/rottensails]Discord[/url] for exclusive tips and to connect with other players
[*] Help shape the game with your feedback
[/list]

[b]The Black Armada awaits your service... if you dare.[/b]
